# huecontroller

`huecontroller` allows to easily control Philips Hue lights from R.

It has intuitive commands that make it easy to make common tasks such as
turning lights on or off and changing brightness or light temperature.

It is functional and can be used to adjust lights at home.

It has a shiny app that allows for controlling light and temperature of
lights,
[`hue_shiny_controller()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_shiny_controller.md)
(you need to use
[`hue_settings()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_settings.md)
with your settings first).

![](reference/figures/README-shiny_screenshot.png)

`huecontroller` can already be used for making video data
visualisations, but sooner or later it will probably have a dedicated
vignette and some more functions to make this easier.

## Installation

You can install `huecontroller` with:

``` r
remotes::install_github("giocomai/huecontroller")
```

## Basic use

First, you’ll need to get you username for the API’s [detailed on the
official
website](https://developers.meethue.com/develop/get-started-2/).

At the beginning of each session, set up parameters: actual ip of your
bridge, and actual username as retrived via the instructions above.

``` r
library("huecontroller")


hue_settings(ip = "192.168.0.111",
             username = "actual_username_from_API")
```

With the following command, you will see all the names of your lights.

``` r
hue_get_lights_names()
```

In all `huecontroller` functions you will be able to refer to light
indifferently using either their numeric id or their *exact* name.

Turn on and off.

``` r
hue_turn_light_on("Living Room 1")
hue_turn_light_off("Living Room 1")
```

Make light a bit brighter.

``` r
hue_set_light_brightness(id = "Living Room 1",
                         brightness = "+",
                         by = 10)
```

Set it to arbitrary birghtness (max = 254)

``` r
hue_set_light_brightness(id = "Living Room 1",
                         brightness = 254)
```

Make it warmer:

``` r
hue_set_light_temperature(id = "Living Room 1",
                          temperature = "+",
                          by = 10)
```

or colder:

``` r
hue_set_light_temperature(id = "Living Room 1",
                          temperature = "-",
                          by = 10)
```

or change colour completely:

``` r
hue_set_light_colour(id = "Living Room 1",
                     colour = "red")
```

## Get and set anything available in the API for specific lights

The following command will output a list object with all available
details shared by the APIs.

``` r
hue_get_light_state(id = "Living Room 1")
```

Details on the exact format of the lights API are [available on the
official website](https://developers.meethue.com/develop/hue-api/).

You can set any of them giving them as a list to
[`hue_set_light_state()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_light_state.md),
e.g. like this:

``` r
hue_set_light_state(id = "Living Room 1",
                    params = list(on = TRUE,
                                  sat = 250, 
                                  bri = 250, 
                                  hue = 2000))
```

Keep in mind that if you want to identify lights by their numeric id,
you should pass the argument as a numeric, not a character, e.g.

``` r
hue_set_light_state(id = 11, # not `id = "11"`
                    params = list(on = TRUE,
                                  sat = 250, 
                                  bri = 250, 
                                  hue = 2000))
```

You can achieve the same with groups:

``` r
hue_get_groups_names()

hue_set_group_state(id = 1, # not `id = "1"`
                    params = list(on = TRUE,
                                  sat = 250, 
                                  bri = 250, 
                                  hue = 2000))
```

## Control all your lights from a browser with Shiny

``` r
hue_shiny_controller()
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`hue_convert_to_hue_sat()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_convert_to_hue_sat.md)
  : Convert hex colour to
- [`hue_delete_group()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_delete_group.md)
  : Delete group
- [`hue_delete_light()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_delete_light.md)
  : Delete light
- [`hue_get_group_lights()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_get_group_lights.md)
  : Get state of given group
- [`hue_get_group_state()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_get_group_state.md)
  : Get state of given group
- [`hue_get_groups()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_get_groups.md)
  : Get all details about groups
- [`hue_get_groups_names()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_get_groups_names.md)
  : Get names of available groups
- [`hue_get_light_state()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_get_light_state.md)
  : Get light state
- [`hue_get_lights()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_get_lights.md)
  : Get details about all lights
- [`hue_get_lights_names()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_get_lights_names.md)
  : Get names of all available lights
- [`hue_mod_group_card_server()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_mod_group_card_server.md)
  : Server function for shiny app
- [`hue_mod_group_card_ui()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_mod_group_card_ui.md)
  : UI function for shiny app
- [`hue_mod_light_card_server()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_mod_light_card_server.md)
  : Server function for shiny app
- [`hue_mod_light_card_ui()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_mod_light_card_ui.md)
  : UI function for shiny app
- [`hue_output_group_id()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_output_group_id.md)
  : Check if given id is valid
- [`hue_output_id()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_output_id.md)
  : Check if given id is valid
- [`hue_set_group_brightness()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_group_brightness.md)
  : Set brightness of group
- [`hue_set_group_colour()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_group_colour.md)
  : Set colour of a group of lights with relevant capabilities
- [`hue_set_group_state()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_group_state.md)
  : Change state of Hue groups
- [`hue_set_group_temperature()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_group_temperature.md)
  : Set temperature of group
- [`hue_set_light_brightness()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_light_brightness.md)
  : Set brightness of light
- [`hue_set_light_colour()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_light_colour.md)
  : Set colour of a Hue light with relevant capabilities
- [`hue_set_light_state()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_light_state.md)
  : Change state of Hue lights
- [`hue_set_light_temperature()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_set_light_temperature.md)
  : Set temperature of light
- [`hue_settings()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_settings.md)
  : Set IP and username to interact with the api
- [`hue_shiny_controller()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_shiny_controller.md)
  : Interactive interface to control lights
- [`hue_turn_group_off()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_turn_group_off.md)
  : Turn off group
- [`hue_turn_group_on()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_turn_group_on.md)
  : Turn on group
- [`hue_turn_light_off()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_turn_light_off.md)
  : Turn off light
- [`hue_turn_light_on()`](https://giocomai.github.io/huecontroller/reference/hue_turn_light_on.md)
  : Turn on light
